title: Initialization-dependent BFGS trial rates for tilted absolute values
summary: Lewis and Overton conjectured in 2008 that, for BFGS applied to the one-dimensional tilted absolute value with their Armijo--Wolfe line search, every nonterminating execution converges at a trial-normalized rate determined only by the tilt parameter and independent of the initial data. We prove that this initialization-independent rate assertion is false. In fact, for every tilt parameter in an explicit open interval, we construct two nonterminating executions with different sharp trial-normalized convergence rates.
